$comment: Patterns in upstream instruction text that may conflict with dfw policies. Hits are warnings shown in validation and update proposals (new hits are highlighted). Rulings live in core/workflow/policies/conflicts.md.

rules.note: Stack choice belongs to gate G3 (policy R1).
New dependencies need approval at G3.
Skills must not change Claude Code settings (policy R10).
Upstream hooks are stripped; dfw runs checks itself (policy R10).
Paid services only on explicit user request with their key (policy R9).
dfw owns PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md (policy R2).
Telemetry must stay off by default (overlay env).
